title: "Aakriti's Animint Gallery"
output: 
  html_document:
    self_contained: false
---

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(kableExtra)
library(knitr)

# 1. Read data
dt <- read.csv('meta.csv')

# 2. Build URLs using the JSDelivr CDN (More reliable than raw.githubusercontent)
# Logic: [https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/user/repo@branch/file](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/user/repo@branch/file)
image_urls <- paste0("[https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/)", trimws(dt$viz_owner_repo), "@main/Capture.PNG")

# 3. Build Demo links
repo_only <- gsub(".*\\/", "", dt$viz_owner_repo)
viz_links <- paste0("[https://aakritixyz.github.io/](https://aakritixyz.github.io/)", trimws(repo_only), "/")

# 4. Create display data frame with raw HTML
display_df <- data.frame(
  Screenshot = paste0("<img src='", image_urls, "' width='200' style='border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 4px; padding: 5px;'>"),
  Project = paste0("<b>", dt$title, "</b>"),
  Links = paste0("<a href='", viz_links, "' target='_blank'>Interactive Demo</a><br>",
                 "<a href='", dt$source, "' target='_blank'>Source Code</a>")
)

# 5. Render
kable(display_df, format = "html", escape = FALSE) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = TRUE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
